sources.title: Search for IP Addresses, Domains and Hostnames
sources.snippet: Use our search function to look up IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, domains and hostnames. You can also use the IP Lookup Tool to find the IP address location of any public IPv4 and IPv6 address, and the WHOIS IP and WHOIS domain tools for WHOIS queries. Or go to our Reverse IP Lookup Tool to show the hostnames that a given IP address resolves to.
